title: Occupant loads for assembly occupancies: consistent calculation method (revision R1)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: January 2025 (platform created January 3, 2025, last updated January 16, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation provides a consistent method for calculating occupant loads for assembly occupancies under the NBC(AE) and NFC(AE).
The Discussion notes that occupant loads may be calculated differently from one jurisdiction to another.
A design occupant load must be indicated so that other professionals can properly design the other required systems.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.

Revision R1 supersedes the April 2024 version (23-BCI-003); the superseded version is kept as a reference.
